# Sanctioned apiKeyHelper mentions, keyed by a hash of FILE + the clause
# containing them (whitespace-normalised, so reflowing prose does not churn this
# file but rewording does).
#
# WHY AN ALLOWLIST. apiKeyHelper shadows a healthy claude.ai OAuth login on
# claude-code >= 2.1.205 and was retired on 2026-07-10 after a multi-day mesh
# outage (anthropics/claude-code#11587, ce-77ip). Earlier versions of the guard
# tried to judge whether prose recommended or disclaimed the wiring, and were
# defeated four times over. Distinguishing those needs parsing, not pattern
# matching, so the guard stops guessing: every mention must be listed here,
# which makes adding or rewording one a deliberate act a human reviews.
#
# WHY FILE + CLAUSE, NOT CLAUSE ALONE. A text-only key lets one entry authorise
# the same sentence ANYWHERE in the repository, so a warning example could
# silently bless real guidance elsewhere. Each site is reviewed on its own.
#
# To add an entry: run
#   go test ./internal/deploy/ -run TestNoAPIKeyHelperInstructions
# The failure prints the clause and the exact line to paste. Read the clause
# first -- if it recommends the wiring, delete the prose instead of listing it.
#
# Stale entries fail the test, so this file cannot drift into fiction.
